about_the_game:
Survival Era is a turn - based strategy survival game that combines resource management and offensive - defensive gameplay. As a pioneer of your territory, you will build a stronghold in the wilderness, fend off 30 waves of enemy attacks, and prove your dominance with wisdom and strategy.

Core Gameplay

Each turn serves as your strategic window:

  • Resource Management: Acquire core resources such as gold and stones by purchasing resource buildings (Gold Crystal Mine, Rock Mine, etc.). Buildings can be upgraded through synthesis to boost output efficiency. Meat resources are used to recruit special units—balancing the allocation of various resources is key to survival.

  • Unit Deployment: Select types and quantities of soldiers in the deployment interface, and drag cards to adjust the battle order—the units placed earlier will enter the battlefield first.

  • Enhancement & Evolution: Spend stones in the enhancement interface to improve building durability and soldiers' attributes (attack power, armor value, etc.), and even unlock special abilities (such as piercing attacks, area explosions), allowing each unit to adapt to your tactical style.

Game Features

  • Turn - based Strategy: After each turn ends, the game automatically settles. The in - game store refreshes purchasable resources and units, and you can also manually spend gold to refresh it, offering more flexible strategic choices.

  • Adjustable Difficulty: From easily fending off enemies to extreme survival challenges, different difficulties bring completely distinct battlefield pressures.

  • Lightweight Experience: Despite its small size, the game includes rich strategic dimensions. Whether you're fighting alone in fragmented time or competing with friends online, you can quickly immerse yourself in the fun of turn - based offense and defense.

Here, every deployment matters for survival, and every enhancement affects the battle situation. Build an impenetrable defense with your wisdom and continue the survival era of your territory through 30 waves of desperation!
